description: At Três Pontas, we only deal directly with small, single family farms that are looking to export their natural whole food products outside their home country for the first time. We search around the world to find only the best farmers for you to buy from directly and only then select the “best of the best” to offer for sale in a true “farm to table” mission. Coming from one of the few olive orchards planted in the cool climate of the Casablanca Valley in Chile, Três Pontas Extra Virgin Olive Oil has a unique and harmonious character. The Casablanca Valley is one of the few valleys in Chile with optimum conditions for producing a premium extra virgin olive oil. The maritime influence from the Pacific Ocean provides cool night-time temperatures and a morning mist that acts as a temperature moderator. This creates a perfect environment for the fruit to ripen slowly & completely. It’s the same reason Chile is known for really great red wines - the same weather conditions produce great olives too! Our farm in Chile practices Sustainable Farming to ensure that the soil and environment around our olive trees will be healthy and productive for generations to come with no negative impacts on the greater community. The farmer we buy from, José Miguel Arnaiz was the first person to plant and harvest olive trees in the Casablanca Valley in Chile about 7 years ago. His olive oil has never been exported to the USA before - until now! Now you can scan the QR Code found on every bottle of Três Pontas olive oil to launch a Google Earth satellite image of José Miguel’s orchard where the olives were born before they started their journey to the United States. All of our olive oil is first cold pressed in Chile and bottled there immediately after harvest.

"Trader Joe's Organic Virgin Coconut Oil, a product that was so sought-after that for the first year we carried it, it was more often than not not on our shelves - we simply couldn't get enough to keep up with demand.

So what makes it so special? Well, to make our Organic Virgin Coconut Oil, our supplier starts with freshly harvested coconuts that are de-husked and grated. The meat of the coconut is dried to remove the water, and then it's cold pressed and filtered to remove any remaining pieces of the fruit. That's the process. Nothing more. Producing the oil in this way, we are able to retain the nutrients, flavor characteristics and aromas of fresh coconuts.

Use Organic Virgin Coconut Oil in cooking - it stands up to relatively high heat and imparts a distinctive flavor - in salad dressings, for baking, and even as a moisturizer for dry skin. It's true! description: Soft and buttery with a lovely extra virgin olive oil Ligurian flavor, this oil is filtered. Although it is now the prime cooking fat of Italian cuisine, the use of olive oil only became widespread in northern Italy after the Second World War; prior to that it was just used in salads, never in cooking. The olives for making oil are harvested in November, December, and January, before they are ripe. They are collected by pickers, either with large wicker baskets, or by spreading large nets around the base of each tree and shaking it. As soon as they are harvested, the olives are taken to the frantoio - or mill - where the oil must be extracted within a week. The best oil is produced from olives processed one or two days after picking. The olives are then cleaned in cold water and then crushed. The kneaded pulp is layered on fibrous mats and pressed between huge stones or metal plates. The whole process takes place without using any heat or chemicals!

All the Siberian pine nuts that we use to produce our extra virgin oil are harvested by hand in the pristine wild forests of Siberia. There are no cities or factories nearby to pollute the air and water. There are no roads. Nothing to disturb the unspoiled Northern wilderness. Our pickers take great care to harvest only the choicest Siberian pine cones that will produce the highest-quality nuts and oil. By gently pressing the delicate Siberian pine nuts at low temperatures (the way it has been done by the people of Siberia for centuries), we obtain a richly flavored, golden-colored gourmet oil which is as delicious as it is healthy.

It is an unfiltered oil, so best to shake it up before consumption.

Selección verde dorado
Muchos chefs y gourmets decorados ya han tomado conciencia del precioso aceite de pistacho. Lo usan en la cocina cuando quieren añadir ese algo especial a sus deliciosas creaciones. El aceite verde del pistacho recuerda a uno de los frutos secos asados y las vacaciones en el sur. Dicen que cuanto más verde sea el aceite, mejor será el pistacho. Esta es una creencia seguida por Podor con su garantía de calidad prensada en frío. Por cierto, cuando usted está sosteniendo una botella de aceite de pistacho de Podor en sus manos está sosteniendo una rareza porque un árbol de pistacho solo produce alrededor de 44.1 lbs de las pequeñas nueces verdes al año.

Usos para aceite de pistacho:
El verde y brillante aceite de pistacho mejorará noblemente su despensa. Solo unas pocas gotas son suficientes para darle a sus comidas un aroma muy especial. El aceite de pistacho tiene un ligero aroma asado que armoniza perfectamente con platos dulces, pasteles y helados. Los aderezos para ensaladas, queso, fideos o arroces también se benefician del maravilloso sabor de este precioso aceite. Este aceite vegetal libera su sabor completo cuando gotea sobre platos terminados y no ha sido sometido a un alto calor.

Almacenamiento:
Sin embargo, puede almacenarse durante 18 meses en un espacio frío y seco protegido del sol. La fecha de caducidad exacta se muestra en la botella.
Después de abrir, se recomienda usarlo dentro de 3 a 4 meses, para que sus valiosas vitaminas, oligoelementos y minerales no pierdan su alta calidad.
Es un aceite sin filtrar, por lo que es mejor agitar antes de consumirlo.

Goldgrüne Wahl.
Viele verzierte Köche und Feinschmecker haben sich bereits auf wertvolles Pistazienöl bewusst. Sie verwenden es in der Küche, wenn sie ihren köstlichen Kreationen das gewisse Etwas hinzufügen möchten. Das grüne Öl aus der Pistazie erinnert an geröstete Nüsse und Feiertage im Süden. Sie sagen, dass je grüner das Öl desto besser die Pistazie ist. Dies ist ein Glaube, der Podor mit seiner garantierten kaltgepressten Qualität folgt. Übrigens, wenn Sie eine Flasche Pistazienöl von Podor in den Händen halten, halten Sie eine Seltenheit, denn ein Pistazienbaum produziert nur ca. 20 kg der kleinen grünen Nüsse pro Jahr.

Anwendungen für Pistazienöl:
Das grün schimmernde Pistazienöl wird Ihre Speisekammer nobel aufwerten. Nur wenige Tropfen reichen aus, um Ihren Mahlzeiten ein ganz besonderes Aroma zu verleihen. Pistazienöl hat ein leichtes Röstaroma, das perfekt mit süßen Gerichten, Kuchen und Eis harmoniert. Salatdressings, Käse, Nudeln oder Reisgerichte profitieren ebenfalls von dem wunderbaren Geschmack dieses wertvollen Öls. Dieses pflanzliche Öl gibt seinen vollen Geschmack frei, wenn es über fertige Gerichte getroffen wird und wurde nicht hoher Hitze ausgesetzt.

Lagerung:
Ungeöffnet 18 Monate an einem kühlen, trockenen und vor Sonnenschein geschützten Ort aufbewahren. Das genaue Ablaufdatum wird auf der Flasche angezeigt.
Nach dem Öffnen empfiehlt es sich, es innerhalb von 3-4 Monaten zu verwenden, damit seine wertvollen Vitamine, Spurenelemente und Mineralien nicht an hoher Qualität verlieren.
Es ist ein ungefiltertes Öl, daher am besten vor dem Verzehr schütteln.

Product Overview:
This Winterized Cottonseed Oil has been has been refined, bleached, winterized, and deodorized (RBWD). Winterization is a fractional crystallization process, where the product is cooled to 32°F and filtered removing a portion of saturated fatty acids and waxes. This results in a product that remains clear at refrigeration temperatures, making it useful in applications such as salad dressings and sauces.

Process Flow:
Derived from the seeds of USDA approved species of Gossypium spp. Solvent extracted. Refined, Bleached, Winterized, and Deodorized. Citric acid may be used as a processing aid and trace levels (~10ppm) may remain. Gossypol is eliminated during the refining process.

GMO Statement:
Non GMO!!!
This term shall be used to describe products that contain ingredients, additives or processing aides derived from commodities that have commercially grown GMO varieties in the supply chain, BUT residual DNA/protein is likely NOT detectable in the final product.
Winterized Cottonseed Oil is refined, bleached, and deodorized (RBD) and does not contain any proteinaceous material. During the RBD process, oil is exposed to high temperatures, vacuum stripping and is filtered through diatomaceous earth; effectively removing all extraneous material that might harbor genetically modified organisms (GMO’s) or substances (protein, DNA) derived thereof.

description: What is it that makes Spartan Oil so unique and so good? The answer to this question is found in the region where the trees grow, the trees and the farmers that care for them, the olives, the harvesting and pressing process and our packaging. The oil is low in acidity, but very high in nutrients and healthy components, including heart-healthy polyphenols and high-density lipoproteins-good fats. (2) the ancient trees & olive varieties: Olive trees are known for their longevity and uniqueness-each tree has its own shapes, twists and character. Many olive trees in the Sparta region are over 500 years old, with several over 700 years old. Our family has farmed these same trees and fields going back at least twelve generations. While the majority of our olive trees are of the famed koroneiki variety,  there are many other varieties present. The diversity of the olives results in an extra virgin olive oil that is complex and flavorful. (3) unfiltered and authentic olive oil: Spartan Oil is not filtered at our production facility, nor is it filtered during the bottling process. We have chosen to avoid filtering the olive oil to preserve the full flavor and nutritional benefits. Families in the Sparta region have enjoyed their olive oil unfiltered for centuries. (4) the bottle matters: To maximize the freshness and shelf-life of the olive oil, we have searched the world over for the optimum bottle. Spartan Oil bottles are all-natural stoneware bottles that resemble the storage containers that ancient Spartans used to store their oil. Aside from their pleasing rustic appearance, stoneware bottles have several specific benefits, including temperature stability, no light transmission, durability and non-reactivity. Cold-pressed.

bullet_point: [Avocado oil is a great tool for cooking flavorful and healthy meals. It’s an excellent source of antioxidants, essential fatty acids, minerals, and vitamins., Avocado Carrier Oil is commonly used in cosmetics, due to its fast rate of penetration and absorption, its high vitamin content, its subtle aroma that can easily be masked, and its excellent preservative., Used in hair, Avocado Carrier Oil straightens and softens strands while nourishing, hydrating, and strengthening them., Avocado has come to be known as “vegetable butter” and “butter pear” due to its high oil content. Avocado Carrier Oil is ideal for use in the manufacturing of soaps for its emollience as well as its lathering and cleansing properties., Avocado Oil is less greasy than other oils, and its emulsifying properties produce finer blends.]
description:
Avocado oil is an edible oil pressed from the fruit of the Persea americana (avocado). As a food oil, it is used as an ingredient in other dishes, and as a cooking oil. It is also used for lubrication and in cosmetics, where it is valued for its supposed regenerative and moisturizing properties.
It is pressed from the fleshy pulp surrounding the avocado pit and not the pit itself. Avocado oil functions well as a carrier oil for other flavors. It is high in monounsaturated fats and vitamin E, and also enhances the absorption of carotenoids and other nutrients.
Because the avocado is a year-round crop, some olive oil processing facilities, particularly in Australia and New Zealand, process olive oil during the olive season, and avocado oil during the rest of the year.
Avocado oil was originally, and still is, extracted for cosmetic use because of its very high skin penetration and rapid absorption. Following drying of the avocado flesh to remove as much water as possible (about 65% water in avocado flesh), avocado oil for cosmetics is traditionally extracted with solvents at elevated temperatures.
After extraction, the oil for application in skin care products is usually refined, bleached, and deodorized, resulting in an odorless yellow oil. Like extra virgin olive oil, cold-pressed avocado oil is unrefined, so retains the flavor and color characteristics of the fruit flesh.

description: Organic Cacao butter - this is the fat that is obtained by hot pressing from the grains of the chocolate tree. Natural Cacao butter has a light yellow, creamy color, the smell of milk with a chocolate note. The typical texture of the product is hard and brittle. The butter easily melted at temperatures above 90 ° F. Cacao butter is the most valuable and significant component of cocoa beans. In fact, the butter is a mixture of fatty acids, which consist of saturated (57-64%) and unsaturated fats (46-33%). The butter has a great composition including arachidonic acid; stearic acid; palmitic and lauric acids; linoleic acid; oleic acid; amino acids. In addition, it contains vitamins A, B, F, C, and E; minerals: iron, magnesium, potassium, iodine, zinc, calcium, chromium and others. The butter has a wide range of uses. Organic Cacao butter is also widely used in traditional medicine as an additional source of beneficial substances. Therefore it does not replace medicines prescribed by a doctor. Due to the content in the oil of biologically active components, it is used in cosmetology, for the manufacture of creams, shampoos, soaps, and other products in cosmetology - for body, face and hair care. Organic Cacao butter is used to soften, mainly in the care of dry skin. The easiest way to use Cacao butter is to make chocolate. Melt the product in a water bath and mix with cocoa powder and sugar in a ratio of one to one. In the mixture, you can add any ingredients to taste, from honey and candied fruit to berries and other dried fruits. As we know, the butter is invariably the basis of chocolate, but it is also added to creams, fudge, and icing to impart the necessary thickness. You can add Organic Cacao butter to drinks and desserts, milk porridges and puddings. The main thing is not to allow it to heat up so that the oil does not lose all its beneficial properties. Recommended storage conditions of the butter is a cool dark place, sealed container.

description: Fractionated Coconut Oil (MCT Oil) is not your regular cold-pressed coconut oil that goes solid at room temperature, though it's ability as an emollient and moisturizer is the same. Fractionated oils have been heated as part of their processing, to separate certain chains of fatty acids into components. This refines, clarifies, and deodorizes the oil. One of the components resulting from this type of processing of coconut oil is medium-chain triglycerides, known as MCT in the industry. This is what comprises Fractionated Coconut Oil. It stays liquid, is clear, and is highly stable for use in creams and lotions, and many other cosmetic preparations for skin and hair. Because it is chemically indifferent to other cosmetic ingredients, it acts as a viscosity regulator and assists in the dispersion of pigments and other additives. Further, it penetrates the skin readily, thus acting as a carrier for transdermal therapeutic ingredients. This ability to transport essential oils and actives makes it an oil of choice among medical practitioners and massage therapists. A percentage of coconut oil in cosmetics is moisturizing; too much of it can be drying. Its saturated nature resists rancidity and makes a very hard soap, while at the same time producing a fluffy lather. Soapmakers usually combine coconut oil with olive, palm, palm kernel or castor oils for an all-vegetable soap. Some soapmakers use between 20% and 30% of a soap batch as coconut oil.

La Tourangelle Avocado Oil is 100% pure, all-natural and handcrafted from premium avocados. Avocado oil is processed on equipment very similar to those used to process extra virgin olive oil. description: Fractionated Coconut Oil (MCT Oil) is not your regular cold-pressed coconut oil that goes solid at room temperature, though it's ability as an emollient and moisturizer is the same. Fractionated oils have been heated as part of their processing, to separate certain chains of fatty acids into components. This refines, clarifies, and deodorizes the oil. One of the components resulting from this type of processing of coconut oil is medium-chain triglycerides, known as MCT in the industry. This is what comprises Fractionated Coconut Oil. It stays liquid, is clear, and is highly stable for use in creams and lotions, and many other cosmetic preparations for skin and hair. Because it is chemically indifferent to other cosmetic ingredients, it acts as a viscosity regulator and assists in the dispersion of pigments and other additives. Further, it penetrates the skin readily, thus acting as a carrier for transdermal therapeutic ingredients. This ability to transport essential oils and actives makes it an oil of choice among medical practitioners and massage therapists. A percentage of coconut oil in cosmetics is moisturizing; too much of it can be drying. Its saturated nature resists rancidity and makes a very hard soap, while at the same time producing a fluffy lather. Soapmakers usually combine coconut oil with olive, palm, palm kernel or castor oils for an all-vegetable soap. Some soapmakers use between 20% and 30% of a soap batch as coconut oil.

The San Giuliano Estates in Alghero, Sardinia, are a clear example of the evolution of the agricultural and food industry towards a reality where the boundaries are extended to include other activities, which in this case, complement the Manca family's tradition of agricultural production. As soon as they are harvested, the olives are taken to the frantoio - or mill - where the oil must be extracted within a week. The best oil is produced from olives processed one or two days after picking. The olives are then cleaned in cold water and then crushed. The kneaded pulp is layered on fibrous mats and pressed between huge stones or metal plates. The whole process takes place without using any heat or chemicals! The first oil extracted from the pressed pulp of the olives is known as the first pressing.

description:
Properties of Safflower Oil
The safflower plant is an annual close to the thistle that grows to roughly 5ft tall in arid, dry climates. Each head has about 20-50 seeds that are cultivated for a number of uses, but mainly for the oil that they contain. Safflower oil is comprised of 78.71% oleic fatty acids, 4.85% palmitic fatty acids, 12.44% linoleic fatty acids, 2.40% stearic fatty acids and .08% linoleic fatty acids. Safflower oil has the highest concentration of linoleic acid that is available on the commercial market.
Uses of Safflower Oil
Safflower Oil has a number of uses both in personal and commercial applications.
Safflower Oil is also used in the industrial sector as a drying oil that is used in the manufacturing of paints and stains and linoleum tile.
The meal that is left over after the oil has been pressed is used in livestock feed; specifically for cows.
Safflower oil can be used in cooking both for deep frying and for salad dressing and marinades. Safflower oil can be used as a nutritional supplement, but it’s most common use is for cooking.
Safflower oil can also be taken as a health supplement. Studies have shown that taking a daily dosage of the oil has reduced inflammation, lowered bad cholesterol, reduced body fat, and promote muscle growth.
The oil can be used to promote healthy hair and nail growth my massaging it into the scalp and nail bed. It is also used in massage oils and lotions as it is low in comodegenic action and doesn’t clog pores.

description:
Cooking with grapeseed oil offers many benefits over traditional cooking oils such as olive oil and canola oil. While relatively new to the US market, this oil has been enjoyed for its health benefits in Europe for many years. Known for health-supporting benefits, superior cooking properties and versatility, it is an excellent choice for all-around cooking needs.
Grapeseed oil is perhaps the most versatile cooking oil available. With a light, wonderful flavor that could be described as "slightly nutty" in character, this oil blends well with more foods than most other oils. It is excellent as a dipping oil, delicious on pastas, perfect for sauteing and stir-frying, and can be used as the primary oil in salad dressings and marinades. It is often used as a base for infusing with garlic and other herbs and spices. Excellent emulsification properties make it ideal for whipping mayonnaise and creamy dressings that you do not want to separate when chilled. The light, subtle flavor will complement any dish without adding an overpowering flavor. It has long been a favorite of gourmet chefs who appreciate its light, nutty, and versatile character.
Grapeseed oil is a healthy food. It is low in saturated fat and high in polyunsaturated fat (Omega-6) which is known to have significant effect in raising good (HDL) cholesterol and lowering bad (LDL) cholesterol. Omega 6, also known as linoleic acid, is not manufactured by the body and must be consumed in our food or through supplementation. Grapeseed oil is the cooking oil of choice for frying, blending, creating, and complementing a host of different foods. No other oil combines flavor, versatility, and health benefits in such a delightful way. It is pressed from grape seeds after wine production. It is environmentally friendly because it requires no new farmland or water to produce. Try it with your favorite dishes - you will soon discover why it is enjoying a rapid rise in popularity in North America.

This Winterized Cottonseed Oil has been has been refined, bleached, winterized, and deodorized (RBWD). Derived from the seeds of USDA approved species of Gossypium spp. Solvent extracted. Refined, Bleached, Winterized, and Deodorized. Citric acid may be used as a processing aid and trace levels (~10ppm) may remain. Gossypol is eliminated during the refining process.

description: Fractionated Coconut Oil (MCT Oil) is not your regular cold-pressed coconut oil that goes solid at room temperature, though it's ability as an emollient and moisturizer is the same. Fractionated oils have been heated as part of their processing, to separate certain chains of fatty acids into components. This refines, clarifies, and deodorizes the oil. One of the components resulting from this type of processing of coconut oil is medium-chain triglycerides, known as MCT in the industry. This is what comprises Fractionated Coconut Oil. It stays liquid, is clear, and is highly stable for use in creams and lotions, and many other cosmetic preparations for skin and hair. Because it is chemically indifferent to other cosmetic ingredients, it acts as a viscosity regulator and assists in the dispersion of pigments and other additives. Further, it penetrates the skin readily, thus acting as a carrier for transdermal therapeutic ingredients. This ability to transport essential oils and actives makes it an oil of choice among medical practitioners and massage therapists. A percentage of coconut oil in cosmetics is moisturizing; too much of it can be drying. Its saturated nature resists rancidity and makes a very hard soap, while at the same time producing a fluffy lather. Soapmakers usually combine coconut oil with olive, palm, palm kernel or castor oils for an all-vegetable soap. Some soapmakers use between 20% and 30% of a soap batch as coconut oil.

Properties of Safflower Oil
The safflower plant is an annual close to the thistle that grows to roughly 5ft tall in arid, dry climates. Each head has about 20-50 seeds that are cultivated for a number of uses, but mainly for the oil that they contain. Safflower oil is comprised of 78.71% oleic fatty acids, 4.85% palmitic fatty acids, 12.44% linoleic fatty acids, 2.40% stearic fatty acids and .08% linoleic fatty acids. Uses of Safflower Oil
Safflower Oil has a number of uses both in personal and commercial applications.
Safflower Oil is also used in the industrial sector as a drying oil that is used in the manufacturing of paints and stains and linoleum tile.

Safflower oil can be used in cooking both for deep frying and for salad dressing and marinades. Safflower oil can be used as a nutritional supplement, but it’s most common use is for cooking.

description:
How to use Gourmet Duck Fat Spray

Use Duck Fat Spray as a non-stick coating vs. those other name brands that are getting some bad press for all the additives they include. (Our spray has none of those nasties.) Lightly spray Duck Fat Spray directly onto your pan or baking dish before cooking/baking. We also recommend applying Duck Fat Spray atop your food to give baked goods this amazingly flaky outer shell, vegetables a versatile coat, and more. Now your herbs and spices will stick to your food for a livelier meal.

If you’ve ever shaken your can of Duck Fat Spray and heard a thud, don’t be alarmed. Inside a can of Duck Fat Spray, there’s a bag of duck fat surrounded by clean compressed air. When you shake it and hear a thud, that’s just the bag of duck fat moving inside of the can.

What to do if my Gourmet Duck Fat Spray stop spraying

Is your spray nozzle clogged? Unfortunately, this can happen from time to time. If your spray stopped working, try this: remove spray tip and run under very hot water, rinsing from the bottom side OR place spray tip in a cup of very hot water. Before replacing the spray tip, place the end of the straw in a cup of water to test the spray. If need be, repeat the process above.

How to store Gourmet Duck Fat Spray?

We strongly recommend storing Gourmet Duck Fat Spray in your pantry or countertop to keep the spray nozzle clear. Duck Fat Spray can be conveniently stored between 65-90˚ F.

What makes Gourmet Duck Fat Spray reusable and recyclable?

Gourmet Duck Fat Spray is reusable because of its high smoke point. It’s harder for breakdown to occur, so duck fat can be used again if you like. However, because you use so little with each spray, it’s unlikely you will need to.

What makes our USA manufactured product recyclable is that we use a recycled, biodegradable can. We like that and know you do, too.

description:
The #1 Keto Refined Coconut Oil

This Refined Expeller Pressed Coconut Oil from Wildly Organic is a flavorless, high-quality, ultra-clean, certified organic coconut oil. An economical choice for cooking coconut oil.

What Does Expeller Pressed Mean?

This keto coconut oil is mechanically expressed using a steam process to refine the oil - without the use of solvents or chemicals of any kind. It is an excellent quality food-grade organic coconut oil that is NOT hydrogenated and contains NO trans fatty acids. This expeller pressed, refined coconut oil has a neutral flavor yet contains the same medium-chain fatty acids as extra virgin coconut oil. Although this coconut oil is less expensive than organic virgin coconut oil, you will not find it lacking in quality or standards. Among refined coconut oils, there are none that are cleaner, clearer, or of higher quality anywhere in the world.

How is it Made?

The organic coconuts are opened and quickly dried. These dried coconuts are then mechanically pressed to remove the oil. No chemical solvents are used at any time during the process. Any free fatty acids in the oil are removed. The filtered coconut oil is run through the earth and is then steam distilled. This yields a pure, uncontaminated coconut oil which is commonly sold as expeller pressed coconut oil; however, to become the ultra-clean oil sold here, it is filtered and cleaned again. The resulting clear, delicious oil is the creme de la creme of expeller pressed coconut oil. It is now the envy of chefs and bakers all over the world. Wildly Organic customers and staff have fallen in love with it.

description: There are very few natural red palm oils available in America. Most palm oil in America has been refined, bleached and deodorized. RBD palm oil has a bland flavor and is completely colorless because all of the antioxidant vitamins have been stripped (carotenoids, tocopherols and tocotrienols). Our sustain-ably sourced, RSPO certified Natural red palm oil still contains these natural substances giving it a dark red-orange color not found in the refined products. Our Natural Red Palm Oil has been allowed to cool to room temperature. This causes the stearic acid to solidify and fall to the bottom of the vat. When the top liquid faction is then decanted, the fatty acid profile is higher in fat soluble vitamins and lower in saturated fats (which have solidified and dropped out). This yields fatty acids similar to olive oil with a very rich red-orange color, much deeper in hue than standard crude red palm oils. Most of the red palm oils that are available in America are not like Wilderness Family Naturals' Natural Red Palm Oil. Instead they are crude palm oils that contain lower levels of carotenoids, tocopherols and tocotrienols and higher percentages of stearic acid, (an 18 carbon chain saturated fat). Another way that Wilderness Family Naturals' Natural Red Palm Oil is different from crude palm oil is in taste. In our Natural Red Palm Oil the free fatty acids have been removed. By doing this, the taste of the palm oil becomes very mild and its shelf life is greatly extended. Wilderness Family Naturals' Natural Red Palm Oil is rich in natural carotenoids (vitamin A), is a good source of tocopherols (natural vitamin E) and contains tocotrienols. It contains about 50% naturally occurring saturated fats and 50% unsaturated fats. The fats in Natural Red Palm Oil are not synthetically hydrogenated or altered in any way. The main fatty acid found in Natural Red Palm is oleic acid, which is the main type of fat in olive oil.

description:
THE #1 KETO COLD PRESSED COCONUT OIL
Our cold-pressed, virgin coconut oil is made like no other. It combines the cold pressing of freshly dried coconut flesh with centrifugation to remove fine proteins and clarify the oil.
How is Cold Pressed Coconut Oil Made?
  • The fresh coconuts are opened and grated.
  • The grated coconut is dehydrated at low temperatures, drying the coconut into fresh, crisp flakes.
  • These flakes are then "pressed" to yield delicious, unrefined coconut oil./li>
  • This oil is a bit cloudy because of the proteins and other components, so it is then placed into a centrifuge to "spin out" the fine particles and clarify.

    • DELIGHTFULLY PURE COCONUT OIL FOR COOKING
    This newest manufacturing technique of centrifuge coconut oil allows for the manufacture of raw coconut oil which does not contain any of the microscopic proteins. It has a mild coconut flavor and is delicious in baked goods. It is delightfully pure, extra virgin coconut oil and likely to be a favorite of those who love to eat coconut oil right off the spoon. Don't be afraid to give it a try - we believe you will be pleasantly surprised! How To Choose Your Organic Coconut Oil
    The Cold Pressed Virgin Coconut Oil and the Centrifuge Extracted Virgin Coconut Oil both melt in your mouth with a nice mild coconut flavor. Both of them have very low moisture content and a very long shelf life. Neither virgin coconut oil is heated during any of the processes. They are both made from non-hybridized, organic coconuts harvested and processed in the Philippines and Sri Lanka.

زيت جوز الهند العضوي المكرر بالبخار من نوتيفا من غير معدل وراثيًا، جوز الهند المزروع بشكل مستدام غني بحمض اللوريك وام سي تي مما يجعله واحدًا من أكثر الأطعمة الفائقة تغذية وتنوعًا في العالم. على عكس الزيوت الأخرى الموجودة في السوق، يتم استخراج زيت جوز الهند المكرر بالبخار من نوتيفا ومعالجته باستخدام البخار بدلاً من الهكسان أو المواد الكيميائية الخطرة الأخرى. في نوتيفا، نبدأ بجوز الهند العضوي غير المعدّل وراثيًا، والذي يتم حصاده بشكل مستدام ومفرم ومعالَج بالبخار لاستخراج زيت جوز الهند النقي والنكهات والروائح بشكل طبيعي في السوق اليوم. هذا الافتقار إلى الرائحة والمظهر المحايد يجعله رائعًا للاستخدام في جميع وصفاتك حيث لا ترغب في نكهة جوز الهند. زيت جوز الهند العضوي المكرر بالبخار من نوتيفا مثالي كزيت طهي عالي الحرارة للقلي والتقليب، كما أنه إضافة صحية للأنظمة الغذائية النباتية والنباتية الخام والأطعمة الكاملة باليو والكيتونية والخالية من الغلوتين. النقاء وكثافة المغذيات لزيت جوز الهند العضوي المكرر بالبخار من نوتيفا يجعله جيدًا لك من الداخل والخارج. استخدمي الزيت الفاتن والمهدئ كمرطب طبيعي للبشرة، أو مزيل مكياج العين، أو علاج ترطيب الشعر العميق، أو امزجيه مع سكر جوز الهند وزيت عطري المفضل لديك للحصول على مقشر منعش للجسم. تأسست نوتيفا في عام 1999 مع وضع هدف واحد في الاعتبار - ثورة طريقة تناول الطعام في العالم. دورنا هو إنتاج وتعزيز الأطعمة الفائقة العضوية والمغذيات المفيدة لك وجيدة للكوكب. المسؤولية الاجتماعية والبيئية هي جزء أساسي من ثقافة وأعمالها نوتيفا. بدءًا من الحصول على منتجات عضوية، إلى الحصول على شهادة التجارة العادلة، إلى تخضير منشآتنا وعمليات تمويل زراعة الأشجار في المدارس في مجتمعنا المحلي، نحن نسعى باستمرار إلى طرق لحماية البيئة بشكل أفضل وضمان جودة حياة أفضل للموظفين والعملاء والمجتمعات التي نخدمها.

description:
THE #1 KETO COLD PRESSED COCONUT OIL
Our cold-pressed, virgin coconut oil is made like no other. It combines the cold pressing of freshly dried coconut flesh with centrifugation to remove fine proteins and clarify the oil.
How is Cold Pressed Coconut Oil Made?
  • The fresh coconuts are opened and grated.
  • The grated coconut is dehydrated at low temperatures, drying the coconut into fresh, crisp flakes.
  • These flakes are then "pressed" to yield delicious, unrefined coconut oil./li>
  • This oil is a bit cloudy because of the proteins and other components, so it is then placed into a centrifuge to "spin out" the fine particles and clarify.

    • DELIGHTFULLY PURE COCONUT OIL FOR COOKING
    This newest manufacturing technique of centrifuge coconut oil allows for the manufacture of raw coconut oil which does not contain any of the microscopic proteins. It has a mild coconut flavor and is delicious in baked goods. It is delightfully pure, extra virgin coconut oil and likely to be a favorite of those who love to eat coconut oil right off the spoon. Don't be afraid to give it a try - we believe you will be pleasantly surprised! How To Choose Your Organic Coconut Oil
    The Cold Pressed Virgin Coconut Oil and the Centrifuge Extracted Virgin Coconut Oil both melt in your mouth with a nice mild coconut flavor. Both of them have very low moisture content and a very long shelf life. Neither virgin coconut oil is heated during any of the processes. They are both made from non-hybridized, organic coconuts harvested and processed in the Philippines and Sri Lanka.

description:
VOLUME: 8 lbs (1 Gallon container)

COUNTRY OF ORIGIN: Malaysia

BOTANICAL NAME: Cocos Nucifera

PLANT PART: from the copra, the dried meat of coconut

EXTRACTION METHOD: separate the copra from the hull of the coconut, then dried, crushed, and expressed to remove the oil, Refined, Bleached, and Deodorized.

ODOR/AROMA: bland to odorless

TASTE: tasteless

COLOR: White to Yellowish

APPEARANCE: soft solid <75F (24C); hard brittle crystalline solid <59F (15C)

CONSISTENCY: slightly thick texture when liquid

FLASH POINT: >500F (260C)

INITIAL BOILING POINT and RANGE: 842F (450C)

AUTO-INGNITION TEMPERATURE: >57F (300C)

C.A.S.: 8001-31-8

SAP Value (KOH): 0.256

SAP Value (NaOH): 0.181

VEGAN: Yes

SPECIFIC GRAVITY: 0.90 - 0.92 (H2O=1)

SURFACE TENSION: 33.4 mN/m (68F/20C)

COMMON USES: Food Safe for culinary use. Ideal in soap and skin care products. A percentage of coconut oil in cosmetics is moisturizing; too much of it can be drying. The saturated nature resists rancidity and makes a very hard soap, while at the same time producing a fluffy lather. Soapmakers usually combine with olive, palm, palm kernel or castor oils for an all-vegetable soap. Some soapmakers use between 20%-30%.

CAUTIONS: Prolonged skin contact may cause irritation in some individuals. A skin test is recommended prior to use, dilute prior to use. Contact with eyes should be avoided as it may cause temporary irritation.

STORAGE: Store in original container.

RECIPE: Bruschetta Chicken Bake
The perfect balance of tomatoes, chicken and mozzarella is the inspiration for this hearty dish.

Active Time: 10 minutes Total Time: 30 minutes

Recipe Ingredients:
1 tablespoon Avocado Oil
1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken breasts, cubed, seasoned with salt & pepper
1½ tablespoons Onion Onion Seasoning
1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
1 (14.5 ounce) can diced tomatoes with basil, garlic & oregano or diced Italian tomatoes, undrained
1 (6 ounce) package herb-flavored stuffing mix
½ cup water

Directions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F. Grease a 13x9-inch baking dish with Avocado Oil. Top with seasoned chicken, Onion Onion Seasoning and cheese.
2. In large bowl, combine tomatoes, stuffing mix and water; stir until moistened. Spoon over cheese.
3. Bake until internal temperature of chicken reaches 165°F on an instant read food thermometer, about 15-20 minutes (or longer, depending on the size of chicken breasts). Place under broiler to brown and crisp topping, if desired.

Makes 6 servings.

Serve with a garden salad.

description: There are very few natural red palm oils available in America. Most palm oil in America has been refined, bleached and deodorized. Our sustain-ably sourced, RSPO certified Natural red palm oil still contains these natural substances giving it a dark red-orange color not found in the refined products. Our Natural Red Palm Oil has been allowed to cool to room temperature. This causes the stearic acid to solidify and fall to the bottom of the vat. When the top liquid faction is then decanted, the fatty acid profile is higher in fat soluble vitamins and lower in saturated fats (which have solidified and dropped out). This yields fatty acids similar to olive oil with a very rich red-orange color, much deeper in hue than standard crude red palm oils. Most of the red palm oils that are available in America are not like Wilderness Family Naturals' Natural Red Palm Oil. Instead they are crude palm oils that contain lower levels of carotenoids, tocopherols and tocotrienols and higher percentages of stearic acid, (an 18 carbon chain saturated fat). Another way that Wilderness Family Naturals' Natural Red Palm Oil is different from crude palm oil is in taste. In our Natural Red Palm Oil the free fatty acids have been removed. By doing this, the taste of the palm oil becomes very mild and its shelf life is greatly extended. Wilderness Family Naturals' Natural Red Palm Oil is rich in natural carotenoids (vitamin A), is a good source of tocopherols (natural vitamin E) and contains tocotrienols. It contains about 50% naturally occurring saturated fats and 50% unsaturated fats. The fats in Natural Red Palm Oil are not synthetically hydrogenated or altered in any way. The main fatty acid found in Natural Red Palm is oleic acid, which is the main type of fat in olive oil.

description:
The geographic origin of the Aglandau Olive is the area around Aix-en-Provence France, near where we live. It is a popular olive tree in Provence France, it has a high yield for farmers. It’s the French Varietal with the most piquant & let me explain that. The word in French is ardente, directly translated into English, fiery. There is a difference between ardente and bitter. Bitter olive oil enters your mouth, you immediately find it bitter, not pleasant at all. Olive oil with ardente enters your mouth wonderful, it is very fruity and flavorful, very pleasant, only after you swallow, it leaves a pepper kick in the back of your throat. Olive oils with a little bit of ardente in them are going to take cooking well and not fall flat.

Doux in French (soft) Olive Oils do not hold up to cooking although they are excellent served cold. Aglandau is robust and flavorful, when you cook with it your food is going to be flavorful, and when you cook with it you do not in fact taste any pepper kick at all, that is only when you drink it pure like we Judges do.

There is much variance year over year, it’s sensitive to the weather, like fine wines, it’s fruity with a GOOD robust flavor.

We are very careful to pick the Aglandau at the right moment of ripeness. If we pick it to early the oil will NOT be ardente, in fact it will be bitter. We always pick the Aglandau last.

850 mg/kg Polyphenols, 0.19 Acidity, 3.7 Peroxide.

MAX Upper Limit under European Law for Extra Virgin Classification is 0.80 Acidity and 20 Peroxide.

We are WAY below the max limits for Extra Virgin Olive Oil classification in acidity and peroxide (naturally occurs in olive oil) which is an indication of the High Quality of the olive oil.

A good average amount of polyphenols in olive oil is 500 mg/kg, it is the polyphenols in the olive oil that makes it healthy, lowers your cholesterol, is good for your heart. 2018 Aglandau has a remarkable 850 in polyphenols

Su alto contenido de polifenol indica una vida útil particularmente larga.

Die Marques de Grinon hat die letzten dreißig Jahre der einmaligen Revolutionierung der feinen Wein- und Olivenölproduktion in der Region La Mancha gewidmet. Wir freuen uns, Ihnen das exquisite Ergebnis seines Capilla de Fraile Estate vorstellen zu können, Marques de Grinon Extra Virgin Olivenöl hat ein lebendiges und intensives Aroma, Frische und angenehme Würzigkeit in seiner Oberfläche. Verpackt in dunklem Bordeaux-Glas, das mit dem königlichen Grinon-Wappen glänzt. Marques de Grinon Extra Virgin Olivenöl wird empfohlen zum Nieseln über gebratenes Gemüse, gefrorenem Fleisch und gegrilltem Fisch, es ist auch hervorragend zum Werfen mit Nudeln und Salaten und zum Eintauchen mit herzhaftem Brot. Sein hoher Polyphenolgehalt zeigt eine besonders lange Lebensdauer an.

Marques de Grinon 在过去三十年里致力于彻底改变拉曼查地区的葡萄酒和橄榄油生产。 我们很高兴向您介绍他的 Capilla de Fraile Estate Marques de Grinon 特级初榨橄榄油的精致结果,清新的香气和令人愉快的辛辣。 采用深色波尔多风格玻璃包装，闪闪发光的皇家格林诺徽章和格林诺世界级葡萄酒一样闪闪发光，由摩伊-Hennessy在全球经销，该油主要由阿贝奎纳和曼桑拿利亚混合。 Marques de Grinon 特级初榨橄榄油适合淋在烤蔬菜、固化肉和烤鱼上,也非常适合与意大利面和沙拉搭配,蘸上丰盛的面包。 其高多酚含量表示寿命特别长。

Marques de Grinon은 지난 30년 동안 라만차 지역의 고급 와인과 올리브 오일 생산에 혁신을 가져왔습니다. Capilla de Fraile 부동산인 Marques de Grinon 엑스트라 버진 올리브 오일은 생생하고 강렬한 향기, 신선함 및 기분 좋은 매운맛을 가지고 있습니다. Marques de Grinon 엑스트라 버진 올리브 오일은 구운 채소, 경화 고기, 생선 구이에 이슬비에 뿌리는 것을 추천하며, 파스타와 샐러드를 던지고 풍성한 빵을 담는 데에도 좋습니다. 높은 폴리페놀 함량은 특히 긴 수명을 나타냅니다.

description:
THE #1 KETO COLD PRESSED COCONUT OIL
Our cold-pressed, virgin coconut oil is made like no other. It combines the cold pressing of freshly dried coconut flesh with centrifugation to remove fine proteins and clarify the oil.
How is Cold Pressed Coconut Oil Made?
  • The fresh coconuts are opened and grated.
  • The grated coconut is dehydrated at low temperatures, drying the coconut into fresh, crisp flakes.
  • These flakes are then "pressed" to yield delicious, unrefined coconut oil./li>
  • This oil is a bit cloudy because of the proteins and other components, so it is then placed into a centrifuge to "spin out" the fine particles and clarify.

    • DELIGHTFULLY PURE COCONUT OIL FOR COOKING
    This newest manufacturing technique of centrifuge coconut oil allows for the manufacture of raw coconut oil which does not contain any of the microscopic proteins. It has a mild coconut flavor and is delicious in baked goods. It is delightfully pure, extra virgin coconut oil and likely to be a favorite of those who love to eat coconut oil right off the spoon. Don't be afraid to give it a try - we believe you will be pleasantly surprised! How To Choose Your Organic Coconut Oil
    The Cold Pressed Virgin Coconut Oil and the Centrifuge Extracted Virgin Coconut Oil both melt in your mouth with a nice mild coconut flavor. Both of them have very low moisture content and a very long shelf life. Neither virgin coconut oil is heated during any of the processes. They are both made from non-hybridized, organic coconuts harvested and processed in the Philippines and Sri Lanka.
    Please note that coconut oil may arrive in liquid or solid form. Coconut oil has a melting point of 76 degrees Fahrenheit. This is completely normal and okay and does not qualify the product for a return or refund.

La Tourangelle Hazelnut Oil is pure, all-natural and handcrafted in our California mill strictly following a 150-year-old French traditional method. Hazelnuts are first ground and slowly roasted to perfection in cast-iron kettles, then expeller-pressed and lightly filtered. The result is a divine gold oil that will add a rich hazelnut velvety taste to all your dishes and is perfect to dip with bread. Roasted hazelnut oil is a well-kept secret of many top chefs that use it in salad dressing, pasta, grilled meat or fish and baked pastries. As substitute to butter, it adds just enough flavors to brownies, quinoa, millet and other grains. It also has significant health benefits combining the exact same fatty acid composition than olive oil and a high level of omega 9 (10.9 gram per serving). Suitable for high-medium heat, Roasted hazelnut is perfect also for sautéing vegetables and roasted meats. Once you discover hazelnut oil, you will return time and time to rediscover this versatile treasure. Origin of hazelnuts: Oregon. Refrigerate after opening. Suitable for medium-high heat. La Tourangelle is one of few remaining oil mills keeping a time-honored French heritage of roasting and pressing nut kernels into delicious oils. We are a family-owned company whose mastery of oil production is the fruit of passion, integrity, and pride. We strive to be the best artisan oil producer, dedicated to making carefully crafted, sustainable, natural products. With artisan care, we extract the seeds' essence and hidden natural treasures to create amazing products that bring delight in the kitchen and well being for the body.

El aceite de avellana La Tourangelle es puro, totalmente natural y hecho a mano en nuestro molino de California siguiendo estrictamente un método tradicional francés de 150 años. Las avellanas se muelen primero y se tostan lentamente a la perfección en las calderas de hierro fundido, luego prensado por expulsor y ligeramente filtrado. El resultado es un aceite de oro divino que agregará un rico sabor aterciopelado de avellana a todos sus platos y es perfecto para sumergirse con pan. El aceite de avellana asado es un secreto bien cuidado de muchos chefs que lo utilizan en aderezos para ensaladas, pastas, carne a la parrilla o pescado y pasteles horneados. Como sustituto de la mantequilla, añade sólo suficientes sabores a los brownies, quinua, mijo y otros granos. También tiene beneficios significativos para la salud combinando exactamente la misma composición de ácidos grasos que el aceite de oliva y un alto nivel de omega 9 (0.38 oz por porción). Adecuado para altas temperaturas medias, la avellana asada es perfecta también para saltear verduras y carnes asadas. Una vez que descubras el aceite de avellana, regresarás tiempo y tiempo para redescubrir este versátil tesoro. Origen de las avellanas: Oregón. Refrigere después de abrir. Adecuado para calor medio-alto. La Tourangelle es uno de los pocos molinos de aceite que quedan manteniendo una herencia francesa de asado y prensado de granos de nueces en deliciosos aceites. Somos una empresa familiar cuyo dominio de la producción de petróleo es fruto de la pasión, la integridad y el orgullo. Nos esforzamos por ser el mejor productor de aceite artesanal, dedicado a la fabricación de productos naturales y sostenibles cuidadosamente elaborados. Con el cuidado artesanal, extraemos la esencia de las semillas y tesoros naturales escondidos para crear increíbles productos que traen deleite en la cocina y bienestar para el cuerpo.

שמן אגוזי לוז La Tourangelle הוא טהור, טבעי לחלוטין ועשוי בעבודת יד במפעל שלנו בקליפורניה תוך הקפדה על שיטה מסורתית צרפתית בת 150 שנה. אגוזי לוז הם הקרקע הראשון וקלויים לאט לשלמות בקומקומים מברזל יצוק, ואז דחוסים בסינון קל. התוצאה היא שמן זהב אלוהי שיוסיף טעם קטיפתי עשיר של אגוזי לוז לכל המנות שלכם והוא מושלם לטבול בלחם. שמן אגוזי לוז קלוי הוא סוד מטופח של שפים מובילים רבים המשתמשים בו ברוטב לסלט, פסטה, בשר גריל או דגים ומאפים אפויים. כתחליף לחמאה, הוא מוסיף מספיק טעמים לבראוניז, קינואה, דוחן ודגנים אחרים. יש לו גם יתרונות בריאותיים משמעותיים המשלבים בדיוק את אותו הרכב חומצות שומן מאשר שמן זית ורמה גבוהה של אומגה 9 (10.9 גרם למנה). מתאים לחום בינוני גבוה, אגוזי לוז קלויים מושלמים גם לטיגון ירקות ובשרים קלויים. ברגע שתגלו שמן אגוזי לוז, תוכלו להחזיר זמן אחר פעם כדי לגלות מחדש את האוצר הרב-תכליתי הזה. מקור אגוזי לוז: אורגון. יש למקרר לאחר הפתיחה. מתאים לחום בינוני-גבוה. La Tourangelle היא אחת מטחנות השמן הנותרות השומרות על מורשת צרפתית מכובדת בזמן של צלייה ולחיצה של גרעיני אגוזים לשמנים טעימים. אנחנו חברה בבעלות משפחתית ששליטתה בייצור הנפט היא פרי של תשוקה, יושרה וגאווה. אנו שואפים להיות יצרני השמן הטובים ביותר לאומנות, המוקדשים לייצור מוצרים טבעיים וברי קיימא. עם טיפול אומנותי, אנו מחלצים את מהות הזרעים ואוצרות טבעיים מוסתרים כדי ליצור מוצרים מדהימים שמביאים הנאה במטבח ורווחה לגוף.

La Tourangelle Haselnussöl ist rein, natürlich und handgefertigt in unserer Kalifornien Mühle streng nach einer 150 Jahre alten französischen traditionellen Methode. Haselnüsse werden in gusseisernen Wasserkochern zuerst gemahlen und langsam bis zur Perfektion geröstet, dann Ausdrücker gepresst und leicht gefiltert. Das Ergebnis ist ein göttliches Goldöl, das Ihren Gerichten einen reichhaltigen Haselnussgeschmack verleiht und perfekt zum Eintauchen mit Brot ist. Geröstetes Haselnussöl ist ein gepflegtes Geheimnis vieler Top-Köche, die es in Salatdressing, Nudeln, gegrilltem Fleisch oder Fisch und gebackenem Gebäck verwenden. Als Ersatz für Butter fügt es Brownies, Quinoa, Hirse und anderen Körnern gerade genug Aromen hinzu. Es hat auch erhebliche gesundheitliche Vorteile, die genau die gleiche Fettsäurezusammensetzung als Olivenöl mit einem hohen Gehalt an Omega 9 (10,9 Gramm pro Portion) kombiniert. Geeignet für hoch-mittlere Hitze, geröstete Haselnuss ist perfekt auch zum Sautieren von Gemüse und Bratenfleisch. Sobald Sie Haselnussöl entdeckt haben, werden Sie Zeit und Zeit zurückkehren, um diesen vielseitigen Schatz wiederzuentdecken. Herkunft der Haselnüsse: Oregon Nach dem Öffnen im Kühlschrank aufbewahren. Für mittlere Hitze geeignet. La Tourangelle ist eine von wenigen übrigen Ölmühlen, die ein altehrwürdiges französisches Erbe des Braten und Pressens von Nusskernen in köstliche Öle hält. Wir sind ein Familienunternehmen, dessen Beherrschung der Ölproduktion die Frucht der Leidenschaft, Integrität und Stolz ist. Wir sind bestrebt, der beste Ölhersteller zu sein, der sich der Herstellung sorgfältig gefertigter, nachhaltiger Naturprodukte widmet. Mit handwerklicher Sorgfalt extrahieren wir die Essenz der Samen und verborgene natürliche Schätze, um erstaunliche Produkte zu schaffen, die Freude in der Küche und dem Wohlbefinden für den Körper bringen.

زيت البندق من لا تورانجيل نقي وطبيعي بالكامل ومصنوع يدويًا في طاحونة كاليفورنيا بدقة باتباع الطريقة التقليدية الفرنسية منذ 150 عام. يتم طحن البندق أولاً وتحميص ببطء بشكل مثالي في الغلايات المصنوعة من الحديد المصبوب، ثم يتم الضغط عليها باستخدام طارد الهواء ومرشحها بشكل خفيف. والنتيجة هي زيت ذهبي فاخر يضيف مذاقًا مخمليًا غنيًا للبندق إلى جميع أطباقك وهو مثالي للغمس في الخبز. زيت البندق المحمص هو سر جيد للعديد من الطهاة المحترفين الذين يستخدمونه في صلصة السلطة والمعكرونة واللحوم المشوي أو الأسماك والمعجنات المخبوزة. كبديل للزبدة ، فإنه يضيف نكهات كافية إلى البراونيز والكينوا والحبوب الأخرى. كما أن له فوائد صحية كبيرة تجمع بين نفس تركيبة الأحماض الدهنية بالضبط مقارنة بزيت الزيتون ومستوى عالٍ من أوميغا 9 (10.9 جرام لكل جرعة). مناسب للحرارة العالية المتوسطة، البندق المحمص مثالي أيضًا لنقع الخضروات واللحوم المحمصة. بمجرد أن تكتشف زيت البندق، ستعيدين الوقت والوقت لإعادة اكتشاف هذا الكنز متعدد الاستخدامات. منشأ البندق: أوريجون. يُوضع في الثلاجة بعد الفتح. مناسب لدرجات الحرارة المتوسطة والعالية. لا تورانجيل هي واحدة من عدد قليل من المطحون الزيتية المتبقية التي تحافظ على تراث فرنسي عريق من التحميص والضغط على حبات المكسرات إلى زيوت لذيذة. نحن شركة مملوكة لأسرة تتميز إتقان إنتاج الزيت بثمار العاطفة والنزاهة والفخر. نحن نسعى جاهدين لنكون أفضل منتج زيوت حرفية، ونكرس جهودنا لصنع منتجات طبيعية ومستدامة ومصنوعة بعناية. مع العناية الحرفية، نستخلص خلاصة البذور والكنوز الطبيعية المخفية لخلق منتجات مذهلة تجلب السعادة في المطبخ ورفاهية الجسم.

O óleo de avelã La Tourangelle é puro, totalmente natural e feito à mão em nosso moedor da Califórnia seguindo estritamente um método tradicional francês de 150 anos. As avelãs são primeiro moídas e lentamente torradas com perfeição em chaleiras de ferro fundido, depois prensadas por expelidor e levemente filtradas. O resultado é um óleo de ouro divino que adicionará um rico sabor aveludado de avelã a todos os seus pratos e é perfeito para mergulhar com pão. O óleo de avelã assado é um segredo bem mantido de muitos chefs que o utilizam em molho de salada, massa, carne grelhada ou peixe e doces assados. Como substituto à manteiga, adiciona sabores suficientes a brownies, quinoa, millet e outros grãos. Ele também tem benefícios significativos para a saúde, combinando exatamente a mesma composição de ácidos graxos que o azeite de oliva e um alto nível de ômega 9 (10,9 gramas por porção). Adequado para calor médio e alto, a avelã torrada é perfeita também para refogar legumes e carnes torradas. Uma vez que você descobrir óleo de avelã, você retornará tempo e tempo para redescobrir este tesouro versátil. Origem das avelãs: Oregon. Refrigerar após abrir. Adequado para calor médio e alto. La Tourangelle é um dos poucos moedores de óleo restantes, mantendo uma herança francesa honrada de assar e pressionar grãos de nozes em deliciosos óleos. Somos uma empresa familiar cujo domínio da produção de óleo é o fruto da paixão, integridade e orgulho. Nós nos esforçamos para ser o melhor produtor de óleo artesanal, dedicado a fazer produtos naturais cuidadosamente trabalhados, sustentáveis. Com cuidado artesanal, extraímos a essência das sementes e tesouros naturais escondidos para criar produtos incríveis que trazem alegria na cozinha e bem-estar para o corpo.

La Tourangelle 榛子油為純天然,嚴格遵循 150 年歷史的法國傳統方法,在我們的加州工廠手工製造。 榛子是第一次研磨,在鑄鐵壺中慢慢烘烤到完美,然後驅逐器壓制並輕輕過濾。 這將是一種神聖的黃金油,將為您的菜餚增添豐富的榛子天鵝絨味,非常適合用麵包浸漬。 烤榛子油是許多頂級廚師保存的祕密,可用於沙拉醬、義大利麵、烤肉或魚以及烘焙糕點。 作為黃油的替代品,它為布朗尼、藜麥、小米和其他穀物添加了足夠的風味。 結合與橄欖油完全相同的脂肪酸成分,以及高水平的 omega 9(每份 10.9 公克),對健康有顯著的益處。 適用於中高熱量,烤榛子也非常適合炒蔬菜和烤肉。 一旦您發現榛子油,您將會回到時間和時間來重新發現這種多功能的寶藏。 榛子產地:俄勒岡州。 打開後請冷藏。 適合中高溫。 La Tourangelle 是少數剩餘的油廠之一,保持了歷史悠久的法國傳統,將堅果粒壓成美味油。 我們是一家家族企業,其對石油生產是熱情、誠信和驕傲的成果。 我們致力於成為最好的工匠油生產商,致力於製作精心工藝、可持續發展的天然產品。 在工匠的護理下,我們提取種子精華和隱藏的天然寶藏,創造令人驚奇的產品,在廚房帶來快樂和身體幸福。

La Tourangelle 헤이즐넛 오일은 150년 된 프랑스 전통 방식을 엄격하게 준수하여 캘리포니아 공장에서 순수하고 천연 소재로 수작업으로 제작되었습니다. 헤이즐넛은 첫 번째 분쇄 후 주철 주전자에 천천히 로스팅한 다음 제거기로 눌러서 가볍게 여과합니다. 그 결과로 모든 요리에 풍부한 헤이즐넛 벨벳 맛을 더하고 빵을 담기에 완벽한 신성한 골드 오일이 탄생했습니다. 구운 헤이즐넛 오일은 샐러드 드레싱, 파스타, 그릴 고기, 생선 및 구운 페이스트리에 사용하는 많은 최고의 요리사의 비밀입니다. 버터의 대용품으로 브라우니, 퀴노아, 밀렛 및 기타 곡물에 충분한 맛을 더합니다. 또한 올리브 오일과 동일한 지방산 구성과 높은 수준의 오메가 9(1회 제공량당 10.9g)을 결합하여 건강에 중요한 이점을 가지고 있습니다. 중간 열에 적합하며 구운 헤이즐넛은 야채와 구운 고기를 볶는 데에도 적합합니다. 헤이즐넛 오일을 발견하면 시간과 시간을 돌려 이 다재다능한 보물을 다시 발견할 수 있습니다. 헤이즐넛의 원산지: 오리건. 개봉 후 냉장고에 보관하세요. 중간 고열에 적합합니다. La Tourangelle은 오랜 시간 동안 명예로운 프랑스 유산을 로스팅하고 견과류 알갱이를 맛있는 기름에 담는 몇 가지 남은 오일 밀 중 하나입니다. 당사는 가족 소유 기업으로 석유 생산에 대한 지배가 열정, 진실성 및 자부심의 결실입니다. 저희는 최고의 장인 오일 프로듀서가 되기 위해 신중하게 제작되고 지속 가능한 천연 제품을 만드는 데 전념하고 있습니다. 장인 정신으로 씨앗의 본질과 숨겨진 천연 보물을 추출하여 주방과 몸에 행복을 가져다 주는 놀라운 제품을 만듭니다.

description: Organic Cacao butter - this is the fat that is obtained by hot pressing from the grains of the chocolate tree. Natural Cacao butter has a light yellow, creamy color, the smell of milk with a chocolate note. The typical texture of the product is hard and brittle. The butter easily melted at temperatures above 90 ° F. Cacao butter is the most valuable and significant component of cocoa beans. In fact, the butter is a mixture of fatty acids, which consist of saturated (57-64%) and unsaturated fats (46-33%). The butter has a great composition including arachidonic acid; stearic acid; palmitic and lauric acids; linoleic acid; oleic acid; amino acids. In addition, it contains vitamins A, B, F, C, and E; minerals: iron, magnesium, potassium, iodine, zinc, calcium, chromium and others. The butter has a wide range of uses. Organic Cacao butter is also widely used in traditional medicine as an additional source of beneficial substances. Therefore it does not replace medicines prescribed by a doctor. Due to the content in the oil of biologically active components, it is used in cosmetology, for the manufacture of creams, shampoos, soaps, and other products in cosmetology - for body, face and hair care. Organic Cacao butter is used to soften, mainly in the care of dry skin. The easiest way to use Cacao butter is to make chocolate. Melt the product in a water bath and mix with cocoa powder and sugar in a ratio of one to one. In the mixture, you can add any ingredients to taste, from honey and candied fruit to berries and other dried fruits. As we know, the butter is invariably the basis of chocolate, but it is also added to creams, fudge, and icing to impart the necessary thickness. You can add Organic Cacao butter to drinks and desserts, milk porridges and puddings. The main thing is not to allow it to heat up so that the oil does not lose all its beneficial properties. Recommended storage conditions of the butter is a cool dark place, sealed container.

description:
Frantoi Cutrera Selezione Cutrera​

This high-end, unfiltered extra virgin olive oil is very well balanced with a bitter, spicy taste and bursts with fragrances of artichoke, oregano and green tomato.  This extra virgin olive oil is made from a variety of five olives:  Moresca, Biancolilla, Nocellara, Cerasuola and Tonda Iblea.  These olives give the olive oil it’s cloudy, green golden-hued color.  

The olives are harvested between November and December in southeast Sicily.  Once the olives are carefully selected they are cold pressed within 6 hours of picking.  This ensures that the intoxicating scents and flavors are locked in.  Cold extracting the olives guarantees a low-acidic olive oil creating the highest-quality olive oil possible.

Pairs Magnificently With a Variety of Foods

This versatile Sicilian olive oil tastes great on grilled meats and fish, fresh soups and salads, bruschetta, sauces, vegetables and much more.  Every cook should have a bottle of this olive oil on hand. High-quality olive oil is a stable for anyone that follows the Mediterranean Diet.  It is rich in monounsaturated fats (the good fat) and antioxidants.  

About Frantoi Cutrera

The Cutrera family’s experience in olive oil production dates all the way back to 1906. Giovanni Cutrera opened his first mill in southeastern Sicily in 1979.  Due to the high demand for their olive oil they decided to open a second mill 1999.  The family owned and operated business is now known globally for creating some of the finest olive oils in the world.

description:
La Tourangelle 100% Organic, Virgin and Unrefined coconut oil is fresh and delicious. It is made from organic coconuts which are expeller-pressed (hexane-free) within 4 days of being harvested by hand. This raw, lightly filtered oil is pure, organic and has incredible coconut flavor. Use it in stir fries, curries and baking, or as a substitute for butter. It also great for use on the skin and hair to heal, protect and beautify. It contains great dietary nutrients such as MCT's (medium chain triglycerids), lauric acid and contains no trans-fat. The melting point of coconut oil is generally quoted as being 76ºF (24ºC). If the temperature is above 76ºF, the oil will become liquid. If the temperature is below 76 ºF, it will solidify. These temperature changes in no way affect the oil. La Tourangelle is one of few remaining oil mills keeping alive the time-honored French heritage of roasting and pressing delicious oils. We are a family-owned company whose mastery of oil production is the fruit of passion, integrity, and pride. We strive to be the best artisan oil producer in the world, dedicated to making carefully crafted, sustainable, and natural products. With artisan care, we extract the essence and hidden natural treasures of the seeds and nuts we press to create amazing products that bring delight to the kitchen and well-being to the body.

Este aceite crudo y ligeramente filtrado es puro, orgánico y tiene un increíble sabor a coco. Utilícelo en patatas fritas, curries y horneado, o como sustituto de la mantequilla. También es ideal para su uso en la piel y el cabello para curar, proteger y embellecer. Contiene grandes nutrientes dietéticos tales como MCT (triglicéridos de cadena media), ácido láurico y no contiene grasas trans-. El punto de fusión del aceite de coco generalmente se cita como 76ºF (24ºC). Si la temperatura es superior a 76ºF, el aceite se convertirá en líquido. Si la temperatura es inferior a 76 ºF, se solidificará. Estos cambios de temperatura de ninguna manera afectan el aceite. La Tourangelle es uno de los pocos molinos de aceite restantes que mantienen viva la tradición francesa de asar y prensar deliciosos aceites. Somos una empresa familiar cuyo dominio de la producción de petróleo es fruto de la pasión, la integridad y el orgullo. Nos esforzamos por ser el mejor productor de aceite artesanal del mundo, dedicado a la fabricación de productos cuidadosamente elaborados, sostenibles y naturales. Con el cuidado artesanal, extraemos la esencia y los tesoros naturales escondidos de las semillas y nueces que presionamos para crear increíbles productos que traen deleite a la cocina y bienestar al cuerpo.

La Tourangelle 100% שמן קוקוס אורגני, בתולי ולא מזוקק הוא טרי וטעים. הוא עשוי אגוזי קוקוס אורגניים שנמצאים בכבישה מהירה (ללא הקסאן) תוך 4 ימים מקציפת ידנית. שמן גולמי מסונן קלות זה הוא טהור, אורגני ויש לו טעם קוקוס מדהים. השתמשו בו בערבוב, קארי ואפייה, או כתחליף לחמאה. הוא גם נהדר לשימוש על העור והשיער כדי לרפא, להגן ולייפות. הוא מכיל חומרים מזינים תזונתיים נהדרים כגון MCT's (טריגליצרידים בשרשרת בינונית), חומצה lauric ואינו מכיל שומן טרנס. נקודת ההיתוך של שמן הקוקוס מצוטטת בדרך כלל כ-76ºF (24ºC). אם הטמפרטורה מעל 76ºF, השמן יהפוך לנוזל. אם הטמפרטורה מתחת ל-76 מעלות צלזיוס, היא תמצק. שינויי טמפרטורה אלה בשום אופן לא משפיעים על השמן. La Tourangelle 100% organisches, unbehandeltes und unraffiniertes Kokosöl ist frisch und lecker. Es besteht aus organischen Kokosnüssen, die innerhalb von 4 Tagen nach der Ernte per Hand ausgepresst (hexanfrei) werden. Es enthält großartige Nährstoffe wie MCT's (mittelkettige Triglyceride), Laurinsäure und enthält kein Transfat. Der Schmelzpunkt von Kokosöl wird im Allgemeinen als 24 ºC bezeichnet. Wenn die Temperatur über 20 °C liegt, wird das Öl flüssig. Wenn die Temperatur unter 76 ºF liegt, wird es verfestigen. Diese Temperaturschwankungen beeinträchtigen das Öl in keiner Weise. La Tourangelle ist eine von wenigen übrigen Ölmühlen, die das altehrwürdige französische Erbe des Röstens und Pressens köstlicher Öle am Leben erhält. Wir sind ein Familienunternehmen, dessen Beherrschung der Ölproduktion die Frucht der Leidenschaft, Integrität und Stolz ist. O óleo de coco 100% orgânico, virgem e não refinado da La Tourangelle é fresco e delicioso. É feito de cocos orgânicos que são prensados por expelidor (sem hexano) dentro de 4 dias após serem colhidos à mão. Este óleo cru levemente filtrado é puro, orgânico e tem um incrível sabor de coco. La Tourangelle 有机、初榨和未精制椰子油新鲜美味。 它由有机椰子制成,该椰子在采收后 4 天内被挤出(无己烷)。 这种原始、轻微过滤油是纯净、有机的,具有令人难以置信的椰子味。 可用于炒薯条、咖喱和烘焙,或作为黄油的替代品。 它也非常适合用于皮肤和头发,以修复、保护和美化皮肤。 它含有优质的膳食营养素,如MCT(中链甘油三酯)、月桂酸,不含反式脂肪。 椰子油的熔点通常被称为76ºF(24ºC)。 如果温度高于 76ºF,油会变成液体。 如果温度低于 76 ºF ,则会固化。 这些温度变化不会影响精油。 La Tourangelle 是少数的油磨厂之一,保留了法国悠久的烘烤和压制美味油传统。 我们是一家家族企业,主要生产油是激情、诚信和骄傲的果实。 我们致力于成为世界上最好的工匠油生产商,致力于制作精心制作的、可持续的天然产品。 通过工匠的护理,我们提取了我们按压的种子和坚果的精华和隐藏天然珍宝,创造出令人惊叹的产品,为厨房带来快乐和身体的健康。

La Tourangelle 100% 有機、初榨和未精製椰子油清新美味。 它由有機椰子製成,在手工收穫的 4 天內經過驅逐器壓榨(不含己烷)。 這種原始、微過濾油是純淨、有機的,具有令人難以置信的椰子味。 可用於攪拌薯條、咖喱和烘焙,或作為奶油的替代品。 也適用於皮膚和頭髮,以癒合、保護和美化。 ​ 它含有大量的膳食營養物質,如 MCT(中鏈甘油三酯)、月桂酸,不含反脂肪。 椰子油的熔點通常被引用為 76ºF (24ºC)。 如果溫度超過 76ºF,油會變成液體。 如果溫度低於華氏 76 度,則會凝固。 這些溫度變化不會影響油。 La Tourangelle 是少數剩餘的油廠之一,保持歷史悠久的法國傳統,烘焙和壓制美味油。 我們是一家家族企業,其對石油生產是熱情、誠信和驕傲的成果。 我們致力於成為世界上最好的工匠石油生產商,致力於製作精心工藝、永續和天然的產品。 ​ 在工匠的護理下,我們提取了我們壓榨的種子和堅果的精髓和隱藏的天然寶藏,創造令人驚喜的產品,為廚房帶來快樂和健康的身體。

La Tourangelle 100% 유기농, 버진 및 비정제 코코넛 오일은 신선하고 맛있습니다. 손으로 수확한 후 4일 이내에 추출 가능한 유기농 코코넛으로 만들어집니다. 가볍게 여과된 이 오일은 순수하고 유기농이며 놀라운 코코넛 향이 있습니다. 볶음튀김, 카레 및 베이킹에 사용하거나 버터 대용으로 사용하십시오. 또한 피부와 머리카락에 사용하여 치유, 보호 및 아름다움을 더하기에 좋습니다. MCT(중쇄 트리글리세리드)와 같은 훌륭한 식이 영양소를 함유하고 있으며 트랜스 지방을 함유하지 않습니다. 코코넛 오일의 녹는 점은 일반적으로 76ºF (24ºC)로 표시됩니다. 온도가 76ºF 이상이면 오일은 액체가 됩니다. 온도가 76ºF 이하인 경우 굳어집니다. 이러한 온도 변화는 오일에 영향을 주지 않습니다. La Tourangelle은 로스팅 및 맛있는 오일을 압착하는 오랜 프랑스 유산을 살리고 있는 몇 가지 남은 오일 밀 중 하나입니다. 당사는 가족 소유 기업으로 석유 생산에 대한 지배가 열정, 진실성 및 자부심의 결실입니다. 저희는 세계 최고의 장인 석유 생산자가 되기 위해 신중하게 제작되었으며, 지속 가능한 천연 제품을 만드는 데 전념하고 있습니다. 장인 정신으로 우리는 누르는 씨앗과 견과류의 본질과 숨겨진 천연 보물을 추출하여 부엌에 기쁨을 가져다 주고 몸에 웰빙을 가져다 주는 놀라운 제품을 만듭니다.

THE STORY OF ATLAS OLIVE OIL

Producing only ultra-premium extra virgin Olive Oil has been our family tradition for more than a century in Morocco.

We plant our olive trees in a harsh rocky desert in the foothills of the snow-covered Atlas Mountains. The significant temperature variations during the day and night (124 F in summer with extremely cold nights), the rocky soil and scarcity of water stresses the olive trees, which causes them to produce high levels of antioxidants, including hydroxytyrosol (which is only found in nature in olive oil and olive leaf and contributes to olive oil’s healthy reputation).

Irrigated by the waters coming from the Atlas Mountains, constitutes a real oasis where a high quality, delicate and aromatic olive oil is produced.

PASSION FOR AGRICULTURE

A passion and devotion to agriculture for more than a century defines the tradition of the Aqallal Family. They are known for their engagement with the local community in providing employment and following an ancient olive growing tradition. Constant monitoring of the cultivations and picking at optimal ripeness with only a 20 minute interval between harvest and grinding creates the highest quality product.

HISTORY

To make olive oil is a real art, and in Morocco this art has a name: Atlas Olive Oils. The legend began in 1887 when founder Boujida Aqallal was producing his famous extra virgin olive oil. Since then this noble art has been passed down from generation to generation and is alive and well today at Atlas Olive Oils. Discover the reason why our ultra-premium extra virgin olive oils are works of art.

HOW TO TASTE OLIVE OIL
1. Pour a tablespoon or two of extra virgin olive oil into a stemless wineglass or small glass.
2. Cup the glass in your hands and swirl the oil gently to release aromas.
3. Stick your nose in the glass, and inhale deeply.
4. Slurp a mouthful of oil while inhaling noisily, just as your mother taught you not to eat soup. Drawing air in heightens the flavor. Then, breathe out through your nose.
5. Swallow while concentrating on the flavor.
6. Consider quietly carefully first the general categories (fruitiness, pungency, bitterness), and then expand from there. Write down your observations, and then compare with your fellow tasters.

Are Bobo’s Kosher?
All of our bars are certified kosher by Earth Kosher.
Why isn't there more protein in Bobo’s?
While some of our bars may not have a lot of protein, others do. Two of our bars – Almond Butter and Peanut Butter – have 6 grams of protein or more per bar.
Are these safe to eat while pregnant?
As every pregnancy is different, we recommend consulting with a doctor or dietitian to discuss whether our product would be a delicious fit for your prenatal diet!
What is the shelf life for your bars? Can Bobo’s be frozen to extend shelf life?
The shelf life for each bar is 7 months. Bobo’s can be frozen and enjoyed at a later time.


באחר צהריים גשומים בשנת 2003, בריל סטפורד ובתה "Bobo" חטיפי שיבולת שועל אפויים שהפכו במהרה למועדפים על ידי בולדר ושותף. חטיף שיבולת שועל צנוע זה יש מאז אוהדים נאמנים ברחבי העולם, ללא פשרות על המתכון המקורי, תהליך אפייה קטן או מסורת אמא ובת.

שאלות נפוצות
היכן מיוצרים של Bobo?
כל הברים והעקיצות שלנו מיוצרים במאפייה שלנו בבולדר, קולורדו.
האם ללא מוצרי חלב?
כן, כל Bobo's הם ללא מוצרי חלב.
האם ללא אגוזים של Bobo?
ישנם מספר טעמים של Bobo's המכילים אגוזי עץ ו/או בוטנים. ל-Bobo's יש תוכנית אלרגנים במקום כדי למנוע מגע צולב עם אלרגנים אלה, אך אנו ממליצים לאנשים עם אלרגיות למרכיבים אלה יש להיזהר בעת אכילת המוצרים שלנו.
האם Bobo's טבעוני?
כן, כל חטיפי שיבולת שועל שלנו מיוצרים ללא מוצרים מן החי או תוצרי לוואי.
האם ללא גלוטן של Bobo?
כל אחד מהמוצרים שלנו מוסמך ללא גלוטן על ידי GFCO. המאפייה שלנו היא מתקן ללא גלוטן ואנחנו עוברים בדיקות יומיומיות על כל אצווה של מוטות שיבולת שועל שלנו.
האם Bobo's כשר?
כל הברים שלנו מאושרים כשר על ידי Earth Kosher.
למה אין יותר חלבון בבו?
בעוד שלחלק מהחטיפים שלנו אולי אין הרבה חלבון, אחרים עושים. שניים מהחטיפים שלנו – חמאת שקדים וחמאת בוטנים – מכילים 6 גרם של חלבון או יותר בכל חטיף.
האם הם בטוחים לאכול בזמן ההריון?
מכיוון שכל הריון שונה, אנו ממליצים להתייעץ עם רופא או דיאטנית כדי לדון האם המוצר שלנו יהיה התאמה טעימה לתזונה טרום לידתית שלכם!
מהו חיי המדף עבור הברים שלכם? האם ניתן להקפיא את בובו כדי להאריך את חיי המדף?
חיי המדף של כל מוט הם 7 חודשים. ניתן להקפיא ולהנות ממנו בזמן מאוחר יותר.


An einem regnerischen Nachmittag im Jahr 2003 gebackenen Beryl Stafford und ihre Tochter "Bobo" Haferriegel, der bald ein Boulder, CO-Café-Favorit wurde. Dieser bescheidene Haferriegel hat seitdem treue Fans bundesweit, ohne Kompromisse beim Originalrezept, Kleingebacken-Prozess oder der Mutter-Tochter-Tradition einzugehen.

Häufig gestellte Fragen:
Wo sind Bobo's hergestellt?
Alle unsere Bars und Bisse werden in unserer Bäckerei in Boulder, Colorado hergestellt.
Sind Bobo's Milchfrei?
Ja, alle Bobo's sind frei von jeglichen Milchprodukten.
Sind Bobos nussfrei?
Es gibt mehrere Geschmacksrichtungen von Bobos, die Baumnüsse und/oder Erdnüsse enthalten. Bobo's hat ein Allergieprogramm, um Kreuzkontakt mit diesen Allergenen zu verhindern, aber wir empfehlen, dass Menschen mit Allergien gegen diese Inhaltsstoffe Vorsicht beim Verzehr unserer Produkte haben.
Sind Bobo's vegan?
Ja, alle unsere Haferriegel sind frei von tierischen Produkten oder Nebenprodukten.
Sind Bobo's glutenfrei?
Jedes unserer Produkte ist von der GFCO glutenfrei zertifiziert. Unsere Bäckerei ist eine glutenfreie Anlage und wir werden täglich an jeder Charge unserer Haferriegel getestet.
Sind Bobo's Kosher?
Alle unsere Bars sind koscher von Earth Koscher zertifiziert.
Warum gibt es nicht mehr Protein in Bobo's?
Während einige unserer Riegel möglicherweise nicht viel Protein haben, können andere tun. Zwei unserer Riegel - Mandelbutter und Erdnussbutter - haben 6 Gramm Protein oder mehr pro Riegel.
Sind diese sicher zu essen während der Schwangerschaft?
Da jede Schwangerschaft anders ist, empfehlen wir die Rücksprache mit einem Arzt oder Dietizer, um zu besprechen, ob unser Produkt eine köstliche Passform für Ihre fränatale Ernährung wäre.
Was ist die Haltbarkeit für Ihre Bars? Kann Bobo's eingefroren werden, um die Haltbarkeit zu verlängern?
Die Haltbarkeit jeder Riegel beträgt 7 Monate. Bobo's können gefroren und zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt genossen werden.


في فترة ظهيرة ممطرة في عام 2003، أصبح قالب شوفان الخبز بيري ستافورد وابنتها "بوبوبو" الذي سيصبح قريبًا من محبي قهوة بولدر. لقد أسرت قطعة الشوفان المتواضعة هذه منذ ذلك الحين المعجبين المخلصين في جميع أنحاء البلاد، دون التنازل عن الوصفة الأصلية، أو عملية خبز الدفعة الصغيرة، أو تقاليد الأم والابنة.

الأسئلة الشائعة
أين تصنع بوبو؟
جميع القضبان والعض لدينا مصنوعة في مخبزنا في بولدر، كولورادو.
هل منتجات بوبو خالية من الألبان؟
نعم، جميع منتجات بوبو خالية من أي منتجات الألبان.
هل بوبو خالية من الجوزة؟
هناك العديد من نكهات البوبو التي تحتوي على جوز الشجر و/أو الفول السوداني. لدى بوبو برنامج مضاد للحساسية لمنع الاتصال العرضي مع هذه المواد المسببة للحساسية، ولكننا نوصي أولئك الذين يعانون من الحساسية من هذه المكونات بالتعامل مع الحذر عند تناول منتجاتنا.
هل بوبو نباتي؟
نعم، جميع قطع الشوفان الخاصة بنا مصنوعة من منتجات الحيوانات أو المنتجات الثانوية.
هل بوبو خالٍ من الجلوتين؟
كل منتج من منتجاتنا معتمد خالياً من الغلوتين من قبل GFCO. مخبزنا هو منشأة خالية من الغلوتين ونخضع لاختبارات يومية على كل دفعة من قطع الشوفان لدينا.
هل بوبو كوشر؟
جميع القضبان الخاصة بنا معتمدة من قبل إيرث كوشير.
لماذا لا يوجد المزيد من البروتين في بوبو؟
في حين أن بعض ألواح الصابون الخاصة بنا قد لا تحتوي على الكثير من البروتين، فإن بعضها الآخر يفعل ذلك. اثنان من ألواح منتجاتنا - زبدة اللوز وزبدة الفول السوداني - تحتوي على 6 جرامات من البروتين أو أكثر لكل قطعة.
هل هذه المنتجات آمنة للأكل أثناء الحمل؟
نظرًا لأن كل حمل مختلف، فإننا نوصي باستشارة طبيب أو طبيب تغذية ليناقش ما إذا كان منتجنا سيكون ملائمًا لذيذًا لنظام غذائي ما قبل الولادة!
ما هي مدة صلاحية القضبان؟ هل يمكن تجميد بوبو لإطالة عمر التخزين؟
العمر الافتراضي لكل لوح هو 7 أشهر. يمكن تجميد البوبو والاستمتاع بها في وقت لاحق.


Em uma tarde chuvosa em 2003, Beryl Stafford e sua filha "Bobo" assaram barras de aveia que logo se tornaram um favorito do café Boulder, CO. Esta barra de aveia humilde já cativou fãs leais em todo o país, sem comprometer a receita original, processo de cozimento em pequenos lotes ou tradição mãe-filha.

Perguntas frequentes
Onde são feitos da Bobobo?
Todos os nossos bares e mordidas são feitos em nossa padaria em Boulder, Colorado.
Não contém lactose, o Bobo?
Sim, todos os bobos são livres de quaisquer produtos lácteos.
O Bobo é livre de nozes?
Existem vários sabores de Bobo que contêm nozes de árvore e/ou amendoim. O Bobo's tem um programa de alergia em vigor para evitar contato cruzado com esses alérgenos, mas recomendamos que aqueles com alergias a estes ingredientes tenham cuidado ao comer nossos produtos.
O Bobo é vegano?
Sim, todas as nossas barras de aveia são feitas sem produtos animais ou subprodutos.
O Bobo é livre de glúten?
Cada um dos nossos produtos é certificado sem glúten pela GFCO. Nossa padaria é uma instalação sem glúten e passamos por testes diários em cada lote de nossas barras de aveia.
O Bobo's Kosher?
Todas as nossas barras são certificadas pela Earth Kosher.
Por que não há mais proteína no Bobo?
Enquanto algumas das nossas barras podem não ter muita proteína, outras têm. Duas das nossas barras – manteiga de amêndoa e manteiga de amendoim – têm 6 gramas de proteína ou mais por barra.
São seguros para comer durante a gravidez?
Como cada gravidez é diferente, recomendamos consultar um médico ou nutricionista para discutir se o nosso produto seria um ajuste delicioso para sua dieta pré-natal!
Qual é a vida útil dos seus bares? O Bobo pode ser congelado para prolongar a vida útil?
A vida útil de cada barra é de 7 meses. O Bobo pode ser congelado e apreciado depois.


在 2003 年下午,Beryl Stafford 和她的女儿 "Bobo" 烤燕麦吧,很快成为 COCO 博尔德咖啡馆的最爱。 这款谦逊的燕麦条已经吸引了全国各地的忠实粉丝,对原始食谱、小批量烘焙过程或母女传统没有妥协。

常见问题
Bobo's 在哪里制造?
我们所有的棒和零食都在科罗拉多州博尔德的面包店制造。
Boboo 不含乳制品吗?
是的，所有 Bobos 都不含任何乳制品。
Boboo 无坚果吗?
有几种口味波波波茶含有树坚果和/或花生。 Bobo's 已经制定了防止与这些过敏原交互接触的过敏原方案,但我们建议对这些成分过敏的人在食用我们的产品时应谨慎。
波波的素食吗?
是的,我们所有的燕麦条都不含动物产品或副产品。
Boboo 不含麸质吗?
我们的每一件产品都经过 GFCO 认证不含麸质。 我们的面包店是一个无麸质的工厂,我们每一批燕麦棒都经过日常测试。
波波的犹太洁食吗?
我们所有的酒吧均通过 Earth Kosher 认证。
为什么 Bobo's 中没有更多的蛋白质?
虽然我们的一些蛋白棒可能没有很多蛋白质,但也有一些蛋白棒。 我们的两根棒 - 杏仁油和花生酱 - 每条含有6克蛋白质或更多。
怀孕期间可安全食用吗?
由于每次怀孕都不同,我们建议您咨询医生或营养师,讨论我们的产品是否适合您产前饮食!
您的酒吧的保质期是什么? Bobo可以冷冻以延长保质期吗?
每个棒保质期为 7 个月。 Bobo's 可以冷冻并稍后享用。


在 2003 年下雨的下午,Beryl Stafford 和她的女兒「Bobo」烤燕麥棒,很快就成為了 Boulder, CO 咖啡館的最愛。 這款低調的燕麥棒吸引了全國忠實的粉絲,對原始食譜、小批量烘焙過程或母女傳統毫無妥協。

常見問題
Bobo's 在哪裡製造?
我們所有的酒吧和點心都是在科羅拉多州博德的烘焙店製作。
Bobo's 不含乳製品嗎?
是的,所有的 Bobo's 均不含任何乳製品。
Bobo's 不含堅果嗎?
Bobo's 有多種口味,含有堅果和/或花生。 Bobo's 已經制定了過敏原計劃,以防止與這些過敏原交叉接觸,但我們建議對這些成分過敏的人在吃我們的產品時要謹慎。
Bobo's 是素食主義者嗎?
是的,我們所有的燕麥棒都不含動物產品或副產品。
Bobo's 不含麩質嗎?
我們的每一項產品都經過 GFCO 認證。 我們的烘焙坊是一家無麩質設施,我們每天都會對每批燕麥棒進行測試。
Bobo's Kosher嗎?
我們所有的酒吧都通過 Earth Kosher 認證。
為什麼 Bobo's 中沒有更多的蛋白質?
雖然我們的一些棒可能沒有大量的蛋白質,但有些則有。 我們的兩根棒 - 杏仁醬和花生醬 - 每條有 6 克或更多蛋白質。
懷孕時可以安全食用嗎?
由於每次懷孕都不同,我們建議諮詢醫生或營養師,討論我們的產品是否適合您產前飲食的美味選擇!
您酒吧的保存期限是多少? Bobo's 可以冷凍以延長保質期嗎?
每一條的保質期為 7 個月。 Bobo's 可以冷凍並稍後享用。


2003년 비 오는 오후, Beryl Stafford와 그녀의 딸 "Bobo"는 곧 콜로라도 볼더가 가장 좋아하는 코로라도 카페가 되었습니다. 이 소박한 귀리 바는 전국의 충실한 팬들을 사로잡아 왔으며, 오리지널 레시피, 소량 배치 베이킹 과정 또는 어머니딸 전통에 대한 타협이 없습니다.

자주 묻는 질문
Bobo는 어디에서 만들어집니까?
저희의 모든 바와 물기는 콜로라도 볼더에 있는 베이커리에서 만들어집니다.
Bobo의 유제품이 없나요?
네, 모든 Bobo에는 유제품이 없습니다.
Bobo는 너트가 없나요?
나무 견과류 및/또는 땅콩을 포함하는 보보에는 여러 가지 맛이 있습니다. Bobo's는 알레르기 유발 항원과의 교차 접촉을 방지하기 위한 알레르기 유발 항원 프로그램을 운영하지만, 이러한 성분에 알레르기가 있는 분들은 제품을 먹을 때 주의해야 할 것을 권장합니다.
Bobo의 비건인가요?
네, 모든 귀리 바에는 동물성 제품이나 부산물이 없습니다.
보보의 글루텐 프리인가요?
당사의 모든 제품은 GFCO에서 글루텐 프리 인증을 받았습니다. 저희 베이커리는 글루텐 프리 시설이며 귀리 바의 모든 배치에 대해 매일 테스트를 거칩니다.
보보의 코셔인가요?
모든 바는 Earth Kosher의 코셔 인증을 받았습니다.
보보에 단백질이 더 많지 않을까요?
저희 바 중 일부는 단백질을 많이 함유하지 않을 수도 있지만, 다른 바에서는 그렇습니다. 두 개의 바 - 아몬드 버터와 땅콩 버터 - 바 당 6g 이상의 단백질을 함유하고 있습니다.
임신 중에 먹기에 안전한가요?
임신이 다르기 때문에 의사 또는 영양사와 상담하여 임산부 식단에 맛있게 맞을지 논의하는 것이 좋습니다.
바의 유통 기한은 어떻게 되나요? 보보는 유통 기한을 연장하기 위해 얼릴 수 있습니까?
각 바의 유통 기한은 7개월입니다. Bobo는 나중에 냉동 및 즐길 수 있습니다.

Based in Chiusanico, in western Liguria, Italy, Ranise specializes in olive oils, olives (particularly the Taggiasca olive variety which only grows in this area), and other culinary specialties obtained from natural raw ingredients and free of colorings or preservatives. This area in western Liguria, is characterized by their typical stone walls which for centuries have had the job of holding together the terraces so that the land does not slide down to the sea.
